intro: From nothing — no Partner account, no CLI, no Shopify knowledge — to a Shopify app that gets paid. Follow the steps in order; a step is done when there is something to show, not when you "learned it".
rule: Phases 0–4 are throwaway code written to learn the platform. The real product starts at phase 5; don't build anything permanent before then.

steps.title: Concepts
steps.learn: What Shopify is, what an app is, how the money flows, what runs underneath.
steps.done: I can explain the whole model in my own words — including why a webhook can arrive twice.

quests.title: Create a free Shopify Partner account
Explain to a friend how the money flows: merchant → Shopify → app

steps.title: First running app
steps.learn: Partner account, dev store, Shopify CLI, `shopify app dev`.
steps.done: The app opens inside a dev store's admin.

quests.title: Scaffold an app with Shopify CLI and open it in your dev store

steps.title: Anatomy
steps.learn: OAuth, session tokens, embedded apps, App Bridge.
steps.done: I added my own page to the template and can trace a request end to end.

quests.title: Add a page to your app inside the Shopify admin

steps.title: Data
steps.learn: Admin GraphQL API, scopes, rate limits.
steps.done: A page that lists products and updates one.

quests.title: Read 10 products through the Admin GraphQL API
Save a setting in a metafield

steps.title: Events
steps.done: `orders/create` is caught and written to a database.

quests.title: Process the same webhook twice without a double effect

steps.title: The problem
steps.learn: Market economics, who pays and how much, how winning apps found their one problem — then the painkiller workshop: mine competitor reviews, interview ten merchants, write the problem in one sentence.
steps.done: Ten merchant conversations, a problem statement with every slot filled, a number from the merchant's own mouth, and the cheapest proof already running.

quests.title: Write one merchant problem down in their own words

steps.title: MVP
steps.learn: My actual app — only as much as solves the problem.
steps.done: 3 merchants installed by hand and using it.

quests.title: Put your MVP in front of one real store

steps.title: Money
steps.learn: Billing API, trials, plans, the surprise-invoice trap.

quests.title: Add a paid plan with the Billing API

steps.title: Launch
steps.learn: App Store listing, the review process, early-warning system, community.

steps.title: Brand & scale
steps.learn: One product, one funnel per pain. Offer → labelled proof → daily email flows → founder as the face. Premium is a result, not a price. Seven brands founded 2020+ as use cases, and the people to model. The second sale is the brand.
steps.done: Two pain-point landing pages with conversion numbers, a 5-email welcome flow sending, and one repeat purchase traced to email, not ads.
